# Notebook 30 -- CMIP6-driven discharge simulation & model ranking

**What this notebook does.** Every catchment that was calibrated in HYD_20 is
now driven with each of the 22 bias-corrected CMIP6 historical series
(`qm_corrected/<model>/<tier>/<id>_<var>.csv`, produced by QED_30) instead of
the observed CAMELS forcing:

1. Reads corrected `pr`, `tasmax`, `tasmin` (+ the `method_flag` column so
   **every extrapolated value is counted**, never silently used).
2. Builds daily `PET` with the same method as calibration (Oudin from corrected
   temperatures + catchment latitude).
3. Runs **GR4J with the catchment's calibrated parameters** (warm-up 1981,
   run 1982-2014), and scores simulated vs observed discharge over the
   **out-of-sample evaluation window 2001-2014** (KGE, NSE, PBIAS).
4. Ranks models per catchment on KGE / NSE / |PBIAS|, then aggregates rank
   sums across catchments into a composite discharge-based ranking that
   complements the forcing-based ranking from QED_30.

Rationale: a model can look good as *bias-corrected forcing* but still produce
poor *discharge* (seasonality errors that KGE on daily values does not fully
cancel). This notebook closes that gap before the SSP download shortlist is
finalized.

```{r log-file}
hyd_log_file <- file.path(hyd_output_dir, "hyd_30_log.txt")
```

## 1. Roster: calibrated catchments + their QED tier

```{r roster}
calib <- data.table::fread(file.path(hyd_output_dir, "hyd_calib_summary.csv"),
                           colClasses = list(character = "id"))
roster <- calib[status == "calibrated"]

inv <- data.table::fread(file.path(hyd_qed_dir, "inventory.csv"),
                         colClasses = list(character = "id"))
roster <- merge(roster, inv[, .(id, tier = final_action)],
                by = "id", all.x = TRUE)

# params saved by HYD_20; latitude lookup from topo attributes
params_dir <- file.path(hyd_output_dir, "params")
roster <- roster[file.exists(file.path(params_dir, paste0(id, ".rds")))]

topo <- data.table::fread(hyd_topo_fp, colClasses = list(character = "gauge_id"))
topo[, id := hyd_normalize_id(gauge_id)]
roster <- merge(roster, topo[, .(id, cwc_lat)], by = "id", all.x = TRUE)

cat("Calibrated catchments to simulate:", nrow(roster), "\n")
print(table(roster$tier))
```

## 2. Model list (QED composite ranking order)

```{r models}
ranking <- data.table::fread(file.path(hyd_qed_dir, "model_ranking_overall.csv"))
model_ranking <- ranking$model                     # already sorted best -> worst
models <- model_ranking[sapply(model_ranking, function(m) {
   dir.exists(file.path(hyd_qm_corr_dir, m))
})]
cat("Models with corrected series:", length(models), "\n")
```

## 3. Simulate every model on every calibrated catchment

```{r simulate}
# evaluation-window indices (same as HYD_20)
full_dates <- seq(hyd_period_start, hyd_period_end, by = "day")
i_warm     <- seq(1L, hyd_warmup_days)
i_run_full <- seq(1L, length(full_dates))[-i_warm]
i_eval     <- which(full_dates >= hyd_valid_start &
                    full_dates <= hyd_valid_end)

kge_calc <- function(o, s) {
   keep <- !is.na(o) & !is.na(s)
   o <- o[keep]; s <- s[keep]
   if (length(o) < 365 || sd(o) == 0) return(NA_real_)
   r <- cor(o, s); a <- sd(s) / sd(o); b <- mean(s) / mean(o)
   1 - sqrt((r - 1)^2 + (a - 1)^2 + (b - 1)^2)
}
nse_calc <- function(o, s) {
   keep <- !is.na(o) & !is.na(s); o <- o[keep]; s <- s[keep]
   1 - sum((s - o)^2) / sum((o - mean(o))^2)
}
pbias_calc <- function(o, s) {
   keep <- !is.na(o) & !is.na(s)
   100 * (sum(s[keep] - o[keep]) / sum(o[keep]))
}

# linear gapfill for a numeric vector (only short interior gaps survive)
zoo_gapfill <- function(x) {
   i_na <- which(is.na(x))
   if (length(i_na) == 0) return(x)
   x[i_na] <- approx(seq_along(x), x, xout = i_na, rule = 2)$y
   x
}

# read one corrected series: date, corrected_value, method_flag
hyd_read_corrected <- function(model, tier, id, var) {
   dt <- data.table::fread(file.path(hyd_qm_corr_dir, model, tier,
                                     paste0(id, "_", var, ".csv")),
                           select = c("date", "corrected_value", "method_flag"))
   data.table::setnames(dt, "corrected_value", var)
   data.table::setnames(dt, "method_flag", paste0("flag_", var))
   dt
}

sim_rows <- list(); n_row <- 0L

for (i in seq_len(nrow(roster))) {
   id <- roster$id[i]; tier <- roster$tier[i]; lat <- roster$cwc_lat[i]
   r_pr <- tryCatch({
      # observed reference table (has Qobs_mm + area/lat via roster)
      obs <- data.table::fread(file.path(hyd_inputs_dir, paste0(id, "_obs.csv")),
                               select = c("date", "Qobs_mm"))
      prm <- readRDS(file.path(params_dir, paste0(id, ".rds")))
      lat <- roster$cwc_lat[roster$id == id]

      for (m in models) {
         r <- tryCatch({
            pc <- hyd_read_corrected(m, tier, id, "pr")
            tx <- hyd_read_corrected(m, tier, id, "tasmax")
            tn <- hyd_read_corrected(m, tier, id, "tasmin")

            dt <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = "date", all = TRUE),
                         list(pc, tx, tn))
            dt <- merge(obs, dt, by = "date", all.x = TRUE)
            dt <- dt[order(as.Date(date))]
            dt[, Tmean_C := (tasmax + tasmin) / 2]

            # Gap handling for 365-day-calendar models (noleap): their series
            # carry NA on every Feb 29. Never silently dropped: pr -> 0 mm
            # (conservative), temps -> interpolated between neighbours, and
            # the number of filled days is logged in the summary table.
            n_gap <- sum(is.na(dt$Tmean_C))
            if (n_gap > 0) {
               dt[, Tmean_C := zoo_gapfill(Tmean_C)]
               dt[, tasmax := zoo_gapfill(tasmax)]
               dt[, tasmin := zoo_gapfill(tasmin)]
               dt[is.na(pr), pr := 0]
               if (sum(is.na(dt$Tmean_C)) > 0) {   # too-long gap: refuse
                  stop("unfillable input gaps (n=", n_gap, ")")
               }
            }
            dt[, PET_mm := airGR::PE_Oudin(
                  JD = as.integer(format(as.Date(date), "%j")),
                  Temp = Tmean_C, Lat = lat, LatUnit = "deg")]

            inputs <- airGR::CreateInputsModel(
               FUN_MOD = airGR::RunModel_GR4J,
               DatesR  = as.POSIXct(as.Date(dt$date)),
               Precip  = dt$pr,
               PotEvap = dt$PET_mm)

            run_opt <- airGR::CreateRunOptions(
               FUN_MOD          = airGR::RunModel_GR4J,
               InputsModel      = inputs,
               IndPeriod_WarmUp = i_warm,
               IndPeriod_Run    = i_run_full)

            out <- airGR::RunModel(inputs, run_opt, Param = prm$param,
                                   FUN_MOD = airGR::RunModel_GR4J)

            i_eval_dt <- match(full_dates[i_eval], dt$date)
            o <- dt$Qobs_mm[i_eval_dt]
            # Qsim is indexed within the run window, which starts right after
            # the warm-up -> subtract warm-up length
            s <- out$Qsim[i_eval - hyd_warmup_days]

            flags_eval <- c(dt$flag_pr[i_eval_dt], dt$flag_tasmax[i_eval_dt],
                            dt$flag_tasmin[i_eval_dt])
            n_eval <- sum(!is.na(o) & !is.na(s))

            data.frame(
               id, model = m,
               kge = round(kge_calc(o, s), 3),
               nse = round(nse_calc(o, s), 3),
               pbias = round(pbias_calc(o, s), 2),
               n_eval_days = n_eval,
               n_extrap_values = sum(flags_eval != "within_range" &
                                     !is.na(flags_eval)),
               n_gap_filled = n_gap)
         }, error = function(e) {
            hyd_log(paste("ERROR", id, m, conditionMessage(e)), hyd_log_file)
            data.frame(id, model = m, kge = NA_real_, nse = NA_real_,
                       pbias = NA_real_, n_eval_days = NA_integer_,
                       n_extrap_values = NA_integer_, n_gap_filled = NA_integer_)
         })
         sim_rows[[n_row <- n_row + 1L]] <- r
      }
      "ok"
   }, error = function(e) {
      hyd_log(paste("ERROR catchment", id, conditionMessage(e)), hyd_log_file)
      "error"
   })
}

hyd_sim_summary <- data.table::rbindlist(sim_rows)
data.table::fwrite(hyd_sim_summary,
                   file.path(hyd_output_dir, "hyd_sim_summary.csv"))
cat("simulated rows:", nrow(hyd_sim_summary), "\n")
```

## 4. Discharge-based model ranking

```{r ranking}
ok <- hyd_sim_summary[!is.na(kge)]

# per-catchment ranks (lower = better): KGE desc, NSE desc, |PBIAS| asc
ok[, rank_kge  := data.table::frank(-kge, ties.method = "average"), by = id]
ok[, rank_nse  := data.table::frank(-nse, ties.method = "average"), by = id]
ok[, rank_pbias := data.table::frank(abs(pbias), ties.method = "average"), by = id]

rank_table <- ok[, .(
   n_catchments = data.table::uniqueN(id),
   mean_kge  = round(mean(kge), 3),
   median_kge = round(median(kge), 3),
   mean_nse  = round(mean(nse), 3),
   mean_pbias = round(mean(pbias), 2),
   rank_sum_kge = sum(rank_kge),
   rank_sum_nse = sum(rank_nse),
   rank_sum_pbias = sum(rank_pbias),
   extrap_pct = round(100 * sum(n_extrap_values, na.rm = TRUE) /
                      sum(n_eval_days, na.rm = TRUE), 3)), by = model]

rank_table[, composite_rank_sum := rank_sum_kge + rank_sum_nse + rank_sum_pbias]
rank_table <- rank_table[order(composite_rank_sum)]
rank_table[, discharge_rank := seq_len(.N)]
data.table::fwrite(rank_table,
                   file.path(hyd_output_dir, "model_ranking_discharge.csv"))
print(rank_table[, .(discharge_rank, model, median_kge, mean_nse,
                     mean_pbias, composite_rank_sum, extrap_pct)])
```

## 5. Agreement with the forcing-based ranking

```{r compare}
cmp <- merge(rank_table[, .(model, discharge_rank)],
             ranking[, .(model, qed_rank = seq_len(.N))], by = "model")
cmp[, rank_shift := qed_rank - discharge_rank]
data.table::fwrite(cmp, file.path(hyd_output_dir, "ranking_agreement.csv"))
cat("Spearman agreement between forcing-based and discharge-based ranks:\n")
print(cor(cmp$discharge_rank, cmp$qed_rank, method = "spearman"))
```

## Take-away

- `model_ranking_discharge.csv` ranks the corrected CMIP6 series by how well
  they reproduce **observed discharge** out-of-sample (2001-2014) when driven
  through calibrated GR4J.
- `n_extrap_values` counts every corrected value flagged as extrapolation in
  the evaluation window -- models with large counts are tail-heavy and should
  be treated with the "linear" pr policy for future windows.
- Models that stay in the top-14 under BOTH rankings (QED_30 forcing-based and
  this discharge-based ranking) are the strongest candidates for the SSP
  download shortlist.
